items.title: Zombie Land
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Roleplay as infected zombies and survivors with your friends! These skins are perfect for zombie loving fans.

- 10 skins

items.title: Dark Demons
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Although these demons are evil little tricksters, they still look super cool when they glow in the dark! These demons have neon colors that stand out against their dark figure. Show up at any party and your friends won't be able to take their eyes off your bright colors!

items.title: Dragon Masters
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These dragons are cute but dangerous! Can you master the power of the dragon? Roleplay as a cute fire breathing lizard!

- 11 dragon skins

items.title: Parkour Wall
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Parkour is a minigame that involves jumping to win! Use your skills to scale the giant wall! The challenge will be difficult, but anyone can beat it! Prove you're a true master by conquering this fun puzzle!

items.title: The Village in the Clouds
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Live out your new life on an island in the sky! Move into an abandoned house in a village obsessed with fishing, or strike out on your own and explore! Skyblock roleplay alone or among friends.

- Catch over 20 custom fishing items!
- Rideable gryphon pet and custom cloud boat!
- Fishing competition minigame!
- Become the best fisher in the sky!

items.title: Neko Teen Style
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Neko Teens are among us! Be stylish with them and look pretty with bright colored skins. Join your friends and walk around the city in a pack. With colorful designs, cat ears, and modern styles you'll be fashionable with this pack!

+ 12 skins
+ Perfect for teens
+ Roleplay friendly

items.title: Armor
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
These are some of the coolest armor skins you'll find in the universe! Travel through a futuristic city in style or hang out with your space friends wearing any of these colorful skins! They won't make you stronger but you'll be free to have tons of fun wearing any of these awesome armor skins!

+ Cool modern designs
+ 25 skins
+ 2 free skins!

items.title: Trendy Summer Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Feel that refreshing summer breeze with the latest, hot fashion! Dress up as a beach-goer, scuba diver, and much more with these 12 fantastic skins to really get those summer vibes flowing! Remember - stay hydrated!

- 12 skins to pick from!
- Licensed by Lothiredon and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Lucky Mobs
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Feeling lucky today? Enjoy these fun, happy mob skins that are sure to surprise you! Play as a zombie, creeper, cow, pig, and more!

- 10 skins for roleplay
- Fun and unique for teens
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Xenon Design.

items.title: Pretty Sweet
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
It's a sweet time with a cute collection of beautiful pink skins and best for going out for fun with friends.

- 1 free skin.
- 12 sweet skins.
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Overtales Studio.

items.title: Cute Creepers
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Check out these stylish creepers! They're rocking some bright and trendy outfits, looking amazing and ready to blow your mind!

+ 12 custom creepers for you to choose from!
+ Bright and vivid colors, fun any time!

items.title: Millionaire Game Show
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
It's a mini-game battle royale! Compete in nearly 80 micro-games in this crazy new game show! Featuring 20 unique episodes and hours of fun! The faster you go, the more money you get! With Mr. Rainbow as your host, what could go wrong?
* 79 microgames
* Frantic fast-paced action!
* Win stupid prizes!
* Hilarious writing!
- 1-4 PLAYERS

items.title: Lucky Loot Fortune Skyblock
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Free yourself from the plain old skyblock gameplay! Explore the 5 different unique islands while collecting items in the sky to build your fortune! But be careful, some of the items you collect may surprise you! Get ready to play this action packed map!
* Lucky blocks with a twist!
* Randomized block generators!
* Carefree skyblock skins included!
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Lucky Loot Twisted Skyblock
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Skyblock, but with a twist. Literately! Explore all 5 twisted-looking islands each with its own theme! Find lucky blocks and be careful of surrounding mobs.
* 5 twisted islands!
* Modified lucky blocks!
* Randomized block generators!
* Skins included!

items.title: Lucky Loot Pirate Skyblock
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Ahoy Matey welcome to this epic skyblock! Try to survive as you voyage 6+ flying pirate ships. Look out for those pesky mobs as you collect special lucky block items! See you out there Buccaneer! As always, make sure to be free of the cursed blocks or ye might fall to your doom! 
* Randomized lucky block generators!
* Carefree pirate skins included!
By Giggle Block Studios

items.title: Summer Anime
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
These awesome summer anime skins are finally here! With the trendiest fashion, you will definitely be the coolest one out there! Get together with your cool friends and enjoy the summer vibes!

- 100% AWESOME
- 8 skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.

items.title: Furniture Fury
items.creator: The Misfit Society
items.description:
Smash, crash, obliterate! These days, we all need some freedom. Grab a weapon and let out your stress as you tear through nine buildings, destroying all furniture in sight.

Includes three modes: Cause enough damage before time runs out, break everything as fast as possible, or design a dream home to destroy!

Music by Approaching Nirvana.

items.title: Space City
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Humans have polluted Planet Earth. We were forced to build floating cities to separate ourselves from the toxic waste. Find the vendors in the city, conclude their quests, and claim your jetpack to explore the wasteland below!

- Fight through hordes of monsters on your way to beat 6 challenges.
- Awesome parkour challenge in the wasteland.
- By Varuna & Pathway Studios

items.title: Dwarves: Journey to Far Lands
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Join the expedition with your clan and venture towards the mysterious Far Lands. 
Whether you are a warrior, a wizard, or a hunter, there’s plenty of space for you in the dwarven society. Glory is at your fingertips! Now claim it!

- 15 Unique skins
- By Varuna & Pathway Studios

items.title: Scorched City
items.creator: Vertexcubed

items.title: Anime School Buddies
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
It is school time once again and everyone is waiting to meet their school buddies! Choose your unique look and join your friends in Minecraft.

+ Teen fashion
+ School
+ Anime style
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Trendy City Guys
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Who has the top look in the city? Come along with us and join the game as a town celebrity. Stun your friends with your new fashion look!

+ Urban style
+ City life
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: House Plants
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Who doesn't love plants? Decorate the kitchen, living room, bedroom, any room, with a variety of species. From herbs to bonsai trees to fantasy flora and so many more!

+ Over 40 craftable house plants
+ Give your house that cottage core aesthetic
+ A pretty survival spawn

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Mobs in Suits
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These millionaire mobs have just bought the sharpest new suits they can find! All that's left to do now is to build a mansion!

- 8 mob skins!

This skin set includes:

- Creeper
- Skeleton
- Slime
- Enderman
- Zombie
- Piglin
- Spider
- Pig
